links.outcome: Patient comprehension with formal report plus LLM-simplified report versus formal only
links.effect: 95% reported understanding >50% with simplified report vs 46% without (rank biserial correlation 0.67, p<0.001); simplified reports at 5th-9th grade vs 11th-13th grade for formal
links.quote: Patients with both reports demonstrated a significantly greater comprehension level, with 95% reporting an understanding level greater than 50%, compared with 46% without the simplified report (rank biserial correlation = 0.67, p < 0.001).

links.outcome: Factual accuracy and hallucination rate of LLM-simplified reports by two radiologists
links.effect: All simplified reports at least somewhat accurate; hallucination rate 1.7%; no hallucinations resulted in potential patient harm
links.quote: All LLM-simplified reports were considered at least somewhat accurate with a minimal hallucination rate of 1.7%.
